# The Lantern Help

This help file is synthetic text written for the CHM reader's tests. It names no real product and quotes no real book.

Read the first chapter next.

## Lamps and Wicks

A lamp burns brighter when the wick is trimmed square and the glass is clean.

### Trimming

- Cut the wick straight.
- Wipe the chimney.

![A small test picture](volume:inbox:extracted/doc/img-1.png)

[image: A remote picture](http://example.invalid/remote.png)

| Part | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Wick | 2 |
| Glass | 1 |

## Keeping the Ledger

### Opening a Ledger

Every ledger opens with the date, the keeper's initials and a blank line.

![The same picture again](volume:inbox:extracted/doc/img-2.png)

### Closing Entries

At the end of the week the keeper sums each column and writes the total twice.

#### Totals

The totals agree, or the week is read again from its first entry.
